description: dirk_loading settings. Designs are authored in the in-game studio (/dirk_loading) and stored here; the active design is handed to the loadscreen on connect via deferrals.handover. Everything else here is the CONTENT library — backgrounds, links, music, changelogs, players — which designs bind to as data sources. Nothing in the library assumes how it is laid out; that is the design's job.

activeDesignId.description: Id of the design shown on the loading screen. Set from the studio.

designs.description: The design library authored in the studio. Server-only — never broadcast to clients; only the active design reaches the loadscreen, via deferrals.handover. Empty by default: the web ships the shipped 'dirk-default' look, so a fresh install renders without any saved design.

carouselTime.description: Seconds each background is shown before the next one fades in

backgrounds.description: The background library. Each entry is one slide — a file that ships with the resource, or a full URL. Designs bind to this list; nothing here assumes how many are shown or how they are laid out.

src.description: A path under web/build/assets (e.g. backgrounds/background_1.jpg) or a full URL.

label.description: Optional name, shown only in the settings list.

links.description: Community links. A design decides how these are shown — a row of buttons, a sidebar, one big Discord tile. The icon is only used to tell them apart in the settings list.

icon.description: Set from the preset when the link is created. Shown in the settings list so you can tell entries apart.

songs.description: Background music playlist. `fileName` resolves to web/build/assets/music/<fileName> (or a full URL).

changelogs.description: Changelog entries. A design binds these via a repeat (with a nested repeat over `entries`).

tips.description: Tips, rules or 'did you know' lines a design can rotate through. A design decides whether it shows them and how — this is just the pool.

default.text: Press F1 for the help menu.
Read the rules in Discord before you start.

players.description: Players of the month. Enter a Discord ID per player — the avatar is fetched server-side (src/server/players.lua) and injected as `img` before handover.

img.description: Optional avatar URL. Overrides the Discord lookup — use it when no bot token is set.
